prompt: Fraud committed over the internet has increased significantly in recent years. Why has this type of crime become so common? What can individuals do to protect themselves?
essay:
In the last years, the crimes on the internet like the fraud have increased a lot in all the world. This is a serious problem for everybody who uses the internet. In this essay I will discuss the reasons of this increasing and I will give some advices for the people to protect themselves.

The first reason is that today everybody does everything online. We buy the things online, we pay the bills online and we put all our personal informations on the social media. So the criminals have many opportunities and they can find a lot of data about us very easy. Another reason is that this crime is very safe for the criminal. He can sit in one country and steal the money from a person who lives in another country, and the police can not catch him because it is very difficult to work between the different countries. Also, many old people do not understand the technology very well, so they are easy victims. The criminals send them an email or a message from a fake bank and they believe it.

For protecting themselves, people should use strong passwords and they should never click on a strange link. Also they should not give their bank information to anybody on the phone. It is also good to change the password sometimes.

In conclusion, the online fraud is increasing because our life is online and because the criminals can not be caught easily, and people must be more careful to avoid this problem.
title: Why online fraud keeps growing
